customers.evidence: We place customers at the center of everything we do.

employees.evidence: Our team members are our most valuable resource.

dei.evidence: We value and promote diversity and inclusion in all aspects of business and at all levels.

community.evidence: We make a positive contribution to communities through philanthropy

shareholders.evidence: We want to deliver long-term value for shareholders through a balanced business model, strong risk discipline, efficient execution, and a world-class team.

integrity.evidence: We’re committed to the highest standards of integrity, transparency, and principled performance.

innovation.evidence: Through innovative thinking, industry-leading technology, and a willingness to test and learn, we create lasting value for customers

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, first-person plural voice with absolute framing ('every action', 'everything we do'). Customers lead as the first value and vision focus; team members and integrity follow. Goals use 'We want to' phrasing. Safety is absent. Community and environment appear mainly as list items within corporate citizenship.
